build_vision_model: build a MiniCPMV4_6VisionModel to encode images through the ViT encoder with window attention merger
build_multimodal_model: build a MiniCPMV4_6Model to process images and videos with the vision tower and language model
build_conditional_generation_model: build a MiniCPMV4_6ForConditionalGeneration model for multimodal text generation from images and videos
create_vision_config: create a MiniCPMV4_6VisionConfig to set vision encoder parameters like window kernel size and insert layer id
create_model_config: create a MiniCPMV4_6Config to configure the full multimodal model with text and vision sub-configs
